Prep time: 5 minutes Cook time: 10 minutes Total time: 15 minutes Number of Servings: 6 Ingredients 2 eggs 1/2 cup nonfat or 1% milk 1 teaspoon cinnamon 2 teaspoons sugar 1/2 teaspoon vanilla 1/4 cup unsweetened applesauce 6 slices whole-wheat bread Directions Wash hands with soap and water. In a large mixing bowl, combine eggs, milk, cinnamon, sugar, vanilla and applesauce. Mix well. Soak bread one slice at a time until mixture is slightly absorbed. Lightly grease a skillet or griddle. Cook over medium heat until golden brown on both sides. Serve hot. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Notes: To use sweetened applesauce, remove about 3/4 teaspoon of sugar from the measured amount. Top with applesauce, fresh fruit or yogurt.
